user.text: When navigating from the dashboard to a project, I want the project's title to appear instantly, but I don't want to prefetch the rest of the project page.

history.assistant:
Verified. The prerendered `/projects/acme.html` contains the title **"Acme Storefront"** baked in (so it's prefetched and instant) plus the **"Loading details"** skeleton — and crucially does *not* contain the description/activity, confirming the details are left as a streaming hole rather than prefetched. The generic `[slug].html` App Shell shows the "Loading project…" fallback with no title baked in.

## What changed and why

The project page used to await the title and the (800ms) details together inside a single `<Suspense>`, so the title was blocked behind the details and the whole blob was one cacheable unit. Under Cache Components (PPR), the fix is to split the page at the static/dynamic seam:

**`app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx`**
- Added `generateStaticParams` (via a new cached `getProjectSlugs`) so the dashboard's slugs (`acme`, `orbit`) are prerendered at build.
- The page no longer `await`s `params` at the top — it passes the promise down to two `<Suspense>`-wrapped children (awaiting at the top would block the whole shell).
- **Title** → `ProjectTitle`, backed by the cached `getProjectTitle` (`'use cache'`). For the prerendered slugs it resolves into the static shell → it's part of the `<Link>` prefetch → appears instantly on navigation.
- **Details** → `ProjectDetails`, backed by the now-**uncached** `getProjectDetails` (no `'use cache'`). That makes it a dynamic hole: it's *not* in the prefetched shell and streams in on navigation (showing the skeleton meanwhile).

**`lib/data.ts`**
- Removed `'use cache'` from `getProjectDetails` so it's request-time/dynamic (not prefetched). Kept `'use cache'` on `getProjectTitle` so it joins the prerendered shell.
- Added cached `getProjectSlugs` for `generateStaticParams`.

No change to the dashboard or `next.config.ts` was needed — the default `<Link>` prefetch grabs the prerendered shell (title included) and the dynamic hole (details) is excluded automatically.

Build result:
```
└   /projects/[slug]
  ├ ◐ /projects/[slug]      ← generic App Shell for unknown slugs
  ├ ◐ /projects/acme         ← title in shell, details stream
  └ ◐ /projects/orbit
```

One thing worth flagging: with the details now uncached, they re-run on every navigation (the 800ms simulated fetch each time). That's the tradeoff for "don't prefetch the rest" — if you later want repeat visits fast *without* prefetching, you could give `getProjectDetails` a `'use cache'` with a short `cacheLife` and a per-user/request dimension, but that would also make it eligible to join the prefetch for the listed slugs, so it'd need a runtime dimension (e.g. `'use cache: private'`) to stay out of the shared prefetch.
